environment.description: ECS Fargate task in an isolated subnet (no NAT, no internet gateway). Task role has s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject but is subject to an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/BoundaryNoExternalNetwork) that includes an explicit Deny on ec2:CreateNetworkInterface for any ENI targeting a subnet with a route to 0.0.0.0/0. Additionally, the VPC has no VPC endpoints for any service other than S3 (gateway endpoint) and CloudWatch Logs. The task's security group egress rules only allow traffic to the S3 gateway endpoint prefix list (pl-63a5400a) and the CloudWatch Logs VPC endpoint on port 443. DNS resolution for external hostnames returns NXDOMAIN because the VPC's DHCP option set uses a custom Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint that only resolves *.amazonaws.com and the internal hosted zone.

config.network: Isolated subnet, no NAT gateway, no internet gateway
config.security_group_egress: Only pl-63a5400a (S3 prefix list) and CloudWatch Logs VPC endpoint CIDR on 443
config.dns_resolution: Route 53 Resolver only resolves *.amazonaws.com and internal zones, all other queries return NXDOMAIN
config.container: runs as root, no seccomp profile
